race.title: Horse & Jockey Handicap Chase
race.verdict: STONEYFORD LADY scored over C&D last year and bounced back from a Ballinrobe fall with a good second at Killarney last month. She looks sure to make a bold bid now returned to this venue. Listowel chase winner Potters Pal is open to further improvement on debut for a new yard with Aurea Fortuna also respected after bouncing back to form last time. STONEYFORD LADY (IRE) POTTERS PAL (FR) AUREA FORTUNA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Potters Pal (11/4), Stoneyford Lady (7/2), Aurea Fortuna (5/1), Springboard (7/1), Cappa Hill (8/1), Littlebiggie (10/1), Mags Nelson (12/1), Banjaxed (16/1), That's About Right (20/1), Beauforts Storm (20/1), Burlington House (25/1), Orkneys Jack (33/1)
